concepts.name: Turntable Crane Collar
concepts.mechanism_family: Slewing crane with cable-suspended capture collar
concepts.scoring_sequence: Side rollers center an upright Cup or Pin beneath the collar; the collar closes, the winch raises it, and the turret slews the boom over the selected Goal for lowering.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A rotating crane separates vertical cable lift from horizontal placement and can approach Goals from several headings.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Controlling swing and preventing the suspended object from twisting during travel.

concepts.name: Pocket Chain High-Side Loader
concepts.mechanism_family: Continuous bucket-chain elevator with tipping head chute
concepts.scoring_sequence: A low roller throat pushes lying or upright objects into a flexible pocket; paired chains carry successive pockets upward and invert them over a short top chute.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: The object rides in circulating pockets rather than on a lifting carriage, allowing acquisition to continue while another pocket approaches scoring height.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Pocket shape must retain both orientations without jamming as it rounds the upper sprockets.

concepts.name: Lead-Screw Tilting Table
concepts.mechanism_family: Differential lead-screw lift table with powered orientation nest
concepts.scoring_sequence: Counter-rotating floor rollers draw an object onto a V-shaped table; two independently driven screw struts raise and tilt the table until its front gate opens over a Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: Elevation and controlled discharge come from differential screw extension, without a mast, swinging boom, or scissor stack.
concepts.main_uncertainty: The screws and table guides may experience high side loading when the object sits near the front edge.

concepts.name: Arc-Rail Placement Trolley
concepts.scoring_sequence: The open bay admits a Pin or Cup into the roller cradle; a chain-driven trolley follows paired quarter-arc rails, carrying the cradle upward and forward before a wrist roller meters the object onto the Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A constrained trolley follows a curved placement path instead of translating on a straight elevator or rotating about one arm pivot.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Low-friction guidance through the segmented arc and chain tension around the curve require development.

concepts.name: Twin-Rocker Hand-Off Loader
concepts.mechanism_family: Sequential rocking saddles with controlled hand-off
concepts.scoring_sequence: A front saddle captures a lying or upright object, rocks rearward to stand and elevate it, then transfers it into a second saddle that rocks forward to the chosen Goal height.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: Two short rotary stages pass the object between guarded nests, avoiding one large lift arm and keeping each stage within the chassis envelope.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Reliable hand-off timing across varying Pin and Cup orientations is the principal geometric risk.
